This build doesn\'t include a Firebase configuration yet, so accounts and the community database can\'t work.

1. Create a free project at console.firebase.google.com
2. Add an Android app with package name com.catmap.dubai
3. Download google-services.json into the app/ folder
4. Enable Email/Password sign-in and create a Firestore database
5. Publish firestore.rules and rebuild the app

See SETUP.md in the project for details.

Street-animal posts are checked against nearby posts by the recognition model (pet-recognition-base) in the CatMap AI Server app on the owner\'s PC. The phone and the PC exchange the photos through Firestore, so it works on any network with no cable. When the PC is off, the phone\'s own matching is used.
